description_en: Modifies the status of an online customer service representative
kebab_example: aliyun scsp change-chat-agent-status --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name 123@123.com --biz-method requestLogout --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeChatAgentStatus

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID to generate the value
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent account, which must be unique within the instance (logon name)
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The target status type. Valid values:
 
- requestRest: requests a short break.
- requestLogout: requests to go offline.
- restToWork: switches from a short break to working
parameters.help_zh:
修改到的状态类型
 
- requestRest   （申请小休）
- requestLogout  （申请离线）
- restToWork  （小休转上班）
parameters.name: method
